title: Magika
brief: Google's free, open-source AI-powered file-type detection tool that identifies a file's true content even when disguised (e.g. scripts hidden as images or malware posing as PDFs).
details: An X post from Guillermo Casaus announcing that Google open-sourced Magika — a system that detects the real content of any file even when disguised (e.g. malware posing as a PDF, scripts hidden as images). Free and open-source. The link is the announcement post, not the repo. (x.com is not directly fetchable from this environment; the breakdown reflects the announcement's subject as curated.)
